class.name: MaszynaPantographGeometryReader
class.brief_description: Measures a MaSzyna vehicle's pantograph from its model's data.
class.description: A pantograph as the original's [code]TAnimPant[/code] builds it ([code]DynObj.cpp:5404-5480, 5577-5633[/code]), out of the data the original gives: the arms' dimensions of the type the FIZ names ([code]PantType=[/code]), and only what the FIZ does not give measured from the model - the lower arm's place, the arms' lengths and rest angles, the slider's height over its pivot and its place along the vehicle. A slider the model cannot be measured by takes its place and height from the MMD's [code]pantfactors:[/code]. Read while the vehicle's data is, from the model's description alone and its slider's own vertices ([method MaszynaE3DModelReader.read_submodel_positions]).

method.name: read
method.description: Returns pantograph [param index] of the vehicle as a [RailVehiclePantograph]: [param model] the description of the model file at [param model_path], [param arms] its five submodel names (lower arm, its pair, upper arm, its pair, slider - without a slider the pantograph has no geometry), [param model_transform] where the model sits in the vehicle, [param type] the FIZ's [code]PantType=[/code], [param factors] the MMD's [code]pantfactors:[/code], [param vehicle_height] the FIZ's height of the vehicle [lb]m[rb] and [param control] the channel it is raised by.
